# Curved Spaces official source archive

Author: Jeff Weeks.

Official source archive: https://www.geometrygames.org/CurvedSpaces/CurvedSpaces-Src.zip

Retrieved: 14 October 2026.
Archive SHA256: 94e8d6492c4cb503414a98412ff3b42b4339027611d0feb1440c82f44a1746ca

The archive supplies © 2022 notices and a GPL version 2-or-later grant in 04 Curved Spaces/TermsOfUse.txt, alongside GPL.txt. The 44 copied code files cover every common C/Metal source and the shared C utility/header set selected for these geometry operations. Original archive paths and exact bytes are preserved; platform application frontends, assets and build dependencies are not fully copied.

Inspect CurvedSpacesMatrices.c for Euclidean/spherical/hyperbolic transformations, CurvedSpacesDirichlet.c for domains, CurvedSpacesSimulation.c for motion, and CurvedSpacesProjection.c for viewing. This remains distinct from a Euclidean physical realization in Flower/Crystal.

archive-sources.tsv binds every copied entry to this archive digest, original path, Git blob identity and size. Archive retrieval/copy was verified; engine execution, host compilation, GPU and physical-device acceptance are NOT_RUN.
